description: Use for "what does THC, CBD or myrcene do in the body": the full record of one mapped compound by atlas id, Cannabis Compound Database id, name or PubChem CID. A curated record gives identity and structure identifiers, every target with the action, effect, evidence grade, body structures and PubMed identifiers, the measured binding values (pKi, pIC50, pEC50) from the IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY, the cultivars a laboratory measured it in with their sources, an evidence summary, its cautions and a ready citation. A database compound gives its identity and every measured value at a placed target with its PubMed id or DOI. Educational reference, not medical advice. No doses. Example arguments: {"id":"cbd"}.

id.description: Atlas id ("thc", "bcp"), database id ("CDB000032"), name ("Beta-caryophyllene", "Thymol") or PubChem CID (16078 or "CID 16078").
